paragraphs: Issured sells software under the Mea name that captures and seals images, video, audio and documents from devices a customer already owns. The same material can then be shared, transferred, stored, audited and validated.

MeaConnexus is the remote video interviewing product, positioned around conversations that may face legal challenge. MeaFuse is the digital chain of custody product, covering capture, storage and protection of an asset. Mea products run on iOS, Android, laptop or desktop rather than on hardware bought for the purpose.

The about page organises the offer by sector rather than by named account. Law enforcement is addressed directly, with police departments and agencies named. Government and Public Sector appears among those sectors, described in terms of sensitive data and collaboration across departments.

quote.text: Digitally capture and seal images, video, audio and documents straight from your existing devices.
